reviews.title: Beauty
reviews.comment: This case is a beauty. Simple as that. You know you want it, just buy it. Colour shifting from purple to green, and 3 USB-C front ports. It's decently big so you might need some space if you are putting it on your desk but you already knew that. Basically, it's a "piece". Something you display as your main piece for your battlestation. The inside is black btw so consider that for your build. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Sky69

reviews.title: Very pretty, wife loves it
reviews.comment: Beautiful limited edition case, lots of space and easy enough to work in, my only gripe is that my 360mm AIO doesn't have wiggle room to adjust when mounted to the top of the case and so I cant screw in the final screw on the right side due to front end fans.
reviews.author: David

reviews.title: Pretty darn nice
reviews.comment: I bought the case for a bit of novelty and I needed a new case anyway, I was surprised with how much of the case you can take apart. There was plenty of options to use cable ties and I haven't messed with the infinity rails for the fans but the rails themselves are quite stable. And it looks cool too
reviews.author: xBr0c3x

reviews.title: Decent case but case doesn't support as much as product page says
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/D1FY0j4L8oL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/61kCD8rCkZL._SY256.jpg I do like the the idea of a limited run case, makes it feel exclusive in a way. The case itself is ok quality, for 140$ I did expect the metal to be thicker than the 60$ case I ordered but it wasn't. This case is fairly modular no doubt however the fan and radiator support is not correct with the documentation. First it lists 140mm support in a lot of areas, however the only way these are supported is if you only use a 120-240mm radiator anywhere or only use air cooling.
I'm using a 360 AIO and I am not able to put 140mm fan in the back front or side because it will hit the aio or fans or tubes if using larger radiator, it is also impossible to use push pull on radiator anywhere and still maintain full fan support and sad part is, it's only by a very small amount so they could have made the case like 1 inch bigger and it would have fit everything with no issues.
I didn't feel comfortable forcing things to fit because of the crazy expense to replace anything if it broke. Overall this case is good but it's lacking in a lot of areas, and honestly if you're buying it specifically because of exclusivity more power to you, however if it were a normal case it would definitely be better to go with a different case if you use 140mm fans, want full aio support, or just want full use of the space properly.
reviews.author: Jordan

reviews.title: Pictures don’t do it justice
reviews.comment:
First of all, hats off to those whose packages arrived broken due to poor handling and packaging. That is not fair and Corsair should most have definitely packaged the items better.
I was extremely scared for my own package to arrive shattered as well but thankfully it made it.
Pictures just do not do this justice. Very fun to build in. It was a little hard to close the case with the extension cables I got but that’s because they are pretty chunky and hard to bend. The whole process was mostly a breeze. I put two 200mm fans in the front, 3x120mm reverse fans on the side of the case, and 3x120mm more reverse on the bottom. One 140mm in the back. And my 360mm aio. Since my initial review, I have slowly been switching around my fan configuration and decided to start swapping out my fans for the icue link system for less cable clutter. Anti Sag bracket works great. My little Lian li screen fit perfectly on the left side. One little cool feature about this case is that the power button can be synced with the color of your fans or if you put it on a different argb header just pick something else that’s custom. Airflow is good. Glass panel is a little tricky to get on because you need to make sure the right side latches on to its correct slots and then you push in the left side and secure it. But yeah overall it’s simple and showcases my components nicely without putting the whole focus on a fish tank.
reviews.author: Lizzy B.
